nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint) accumulating the per-game key derived from keccak256(_input + now)/now.
Public mapping(address => uint) counting players in the current game round.
Public mapping(address => uint) holding the current game round index for the contract address.
Public mapping(address => uint) with the number of players required to finish a round (100).
Private mapping(address => uint) recording the game round a player has registered for.
Private mapping(address => uint) assigning a seat number to each player in the round.
Private mapping(uint => address) mapping seat numbers back to player addresses for winner lookup.
Public uint holding the required bet amount (initialised to .005 ether).
Public address used as the key for all per-contract mappings.
Public address of the contract owner, used by onlyOwner and to receive the house fee.
Public address of the most recent round winner.
Public function guarded by onlyOwner that reassigns the owner address.
Public function guarded by noPendingBets and onlyOwner that changes the required bet.
Constructor initialising contractAddress, mappings, owner, currentBet and lastWinner.
Public view returning player status, player count and last winner for msg.sender.
Payable entry point that registers a bet, accumulates the key and performs the payout when the round is full.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal owner.
Modifier requiring playerCount[contractAddress] to be zero.
Modifier validating registration status, player count, msg.value and _input before a bet.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, registration, player numbering and betting.
Block timestamp (now) used as randomness seed in playerKey and winning number generation.
Privileged state write reassigning the owner address without a two-step transfer.
Owner-controlled write of the payable requirement currentBet.
External value transfer to the winner before all state is finalised (reentrancy surface).
External value transfer of the house fee to the owner.
Pseudo-random key derivation from user input and block timestamp.
Arithmetic accumulation of the derived key into state without overflow protection.
Unchecked increment of the player counter for the round.
Unchecked increment of the game round index when the round completes.
Winner selection derived from block timestamp and accumulated player key (weak randomness).
Registration status write binding the caller to the current game round.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the new owner address.
Parameter of changeBet holding the new bet amount.
Parameter of placeBet used as user-provided entropy for the player key.
Local variable in canBet holding the computed registration status.
Local variable in canBet holding the cached player count.
Local variable in canBet holding the cached last winner.
Local variable in placeBet holding the derived per-bet key.
Local variable in placeBet holding the computed winning seat number.
Local variable in placeBet holding the winner address resolved from numberToAddress.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner gates the execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates the execution of changeBet.
noPendingBets additionally gates changeBet on a zero player count.
betCondition gates all state changes performed in placeBet.
msg.sender drives the registration status check inside betCondition.
msg.sender identifies the player whose bet is processed.
msg.sender is used to read registration status in canBet.
msg.sender is the key written into playerRegistrationStatus.
currentGame[contractAddress] is read to stamp the registration status.
Registration status state variable is updated.
block.timestamp (now) is mixed into the keccak256 key derivation.
The derived hash value is divided by now to produce the local _playerKey.
Local _playerKey is added into the playerKey state accumulator.
Unchecked arithmetic write to the playerKey state variable.
User parameter _input is consumed as entropy by keccak256(_input + now).
The player counter increment executes inside placeBet.
Unchecked increment of playerCount state.
The round increment executes inside placeBet when the round completes.
Unchecked increment of currentGame state.
The winner number computation executes inside placeBet.
block.timestamp (now) seeds the winning number computation.
Accumulated playerKey is read as part of the winning number seed.
Result of the modulo addition is stored in local _winningNumber.
_winningNumber is used as the index from which the winner address is resolved.
numberToAddress lookup returns the winner address into _winningAddress.
The resolved winner address is the recipient of the external value transfer.
Payout amount is computed from currentBet state at the time of the external call.
External transfer is executed in the middle of placeBet before state is fully settled.
The external value transfer can call back into placeBet, allowing reentrant betting.
playerCount value is used to assign the seat number stored in playerNumber.
The player number indexes the numberToAddress reverse mapping.
House fee transfer executes inside placeBet.
owner address is used as the recipient of the fee transfer.
Owner reassignment executes inside transferOwnership.
Parameter newOwner is written into the owner state variable.
Privileged overwrite of the owner state variable.
Bet update executes inside changeBet.
Parameter _newBet is written into currentBet.
Owner-controlled mutation of the currentBet state variable.
currentBet is read by the msg.value requirement in betCondition/placeBet.
Local _status is assigned inside canBet.
Local _playerCount is assigned inside canBet.
Local _lastWinner is assigned inside canBet.
currentGame is read to compute the registration status in canBet.
playerRegistrationStatus is read in canBet.
playerCount state is copied into local _playerCount.
lastWinner state is copied into local _lastWinner.
currentPlayersRequired is compared against playerCount in placeBet.
playerCount is read and compared to the required threshold.
playerRegistrationStatus is read to validate the bet.
currentGame is read to validate and advance the round.
Constructor sets owner and lastWinner to msg.sender.
Constructor initialises contractAddress.
Constructor initialises currentGame.
Constructor initialises currentPlayersRequired to 100.
Constructor initialises owner.
Constructor initialises currentBet to .005 ether.
Constructor initialises lastWinner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner is only used to overwrite the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
Parameter _newBet is only used to overwrite the currentBet state variable inside changeBet.
Parameter _input is only consumed by placeBet to seed the player key derivation.
Local _status exists only as the computed return value of canBet.
Local _playerCount only caches playerCount for the canBet return tuple.
Local _lastWinner only caches lastWinner for the canBet return tuple.
Local _playerKey exists only to be accumulated into the playerKey state variable.
Local _winningNumber exists only as the result of the pseudo-random winner computation.
Local _winningAddress exists only to be the recipient of the external payout transfer.
